title: Plugin protocol frame, version 1
description: One line of the newline-delimited JSON stream between the reviewer core and an analyzer plugin (ADR-0025). Stdout carries frames and nothing else; diagnostics go to stderr.

type.description: A receiver ignores types it does not know, which is what makes the protocol additively extensible.

protocol.description: hello, both directions. A mismatch is refused explicitly rather than guessed at.

host.description: hello, host to plugin: host name and version.

plugin.description: hello, plugin to host: plugin name.

version.description: hello, plugin to host: plugin version.

analyzer.description: The analyzer an analyze, findings or error frame concerns.

warnings.description: Things worth saying that are not failures.

message.description: error, plugin to host. Never fatal to the run.

id.description: Stable analyzer name, used in --only and --skip.

lane.description: Declared here so the core can block the model lane without trusting the analyzer.

order.description: Lower runs earlier. The core leaves gaps so plugins can interleave.

available.description: False when the analyzer cannot run in this repository. The core skips it and reports the reason once.

root.description: Absolute path of the repository under review.

changed.description: The files and line ranges in the diff. Analyzers restrict findings to these; the core filters again.

projects.description: Monorepo workspaces in scope. Empty means all.

settings.description: This analyzer's config block, passed through untouched. The protocol does not know its shape, which is how an analyzer gains an option without a protocol change.
